Body.Content:
This feature enhances the Project Budget management experience by improving visibility, usability, and contextual clarity when working with project budgets and budget versions. It addresses limitations of the existing Project form Budget tab and reduces ambiguity around budget version actions.

Since this is a navigation addition, the Budget section is available by default.

Improved budget visibility

Budget information is presented in a dedicated, optimized experience that overcomes space constraints of the Project form.

Key budget attributes and financial details are clearly visible without excessive navigation.

The layout helps project managers quickly understand the current state of the project budget.

Contextual budget version actions

Budget version actions are available directly within the budget context.

The active or selected budget version is clearly indicated before any action is performed.

This provides confidence that actions are applied to the intended budget version.

Simplified navigation and usability

Reduced dependency on the Project ribbon for budget-related tasks.

Actions are aligned closely with the data being viewed.

Improved usability lowers the learning curve and increases efficiency.

Business value

Reduces confusion and errors when managing multiple budget versions.

Improves productivity by minimizing unnecessary navigation.

Enables more informed financial decision-making.

Enhances overall user satisfaction and trust in the system.

Business Value:

Project managers can now view budget information in a more focused and intuitive experience, overcoming the space limitations of the Project form’s Budget tab. Key budget details are easier to access, improving visibility and understanding of project financials. Budget version actions are now clearly contextualized, reducing confusion about which version an action applies to. These improvements help minimize errors, improve usability, and enable more confident and efficient budget management.

Enabled for:

Enabled for end users automatically

GA date: September CY2027

Preview date: September CY2026
